item.title: All-Star Cretin Family Featuring Green Day’s Billie Joe Armstrong, Rancid’s Tim Armstrong & Travis Barker Celebrate Ramones’ 50th Anniversary
item.description:
Trending on Billboard
The all-star Cretin Family band took the stage at Hollywood Forever Cemetery in Los Angeles on Sunday night (Aug. 30) for a raucous tribute to The Ramones that featured some very special guests. The one-night-only performance honoring the pioneering New York punk band’s 50th anniversary included a 19-song set performed by Green Day singer/guitarist Billie Joe Armstrong, Rancid frontman Tim Armstrong, Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker and former Ramones bassist CJ Ramone.
The special event was hosted by actor John Travolta and honored a half-century since the release of the Ramones’ landmark 1976 self-titled debut album. It found the band blitzing through a number of the beloved, deranged songs from that LP, including “Blitzkrieg Bop,” “Beat on the Brat
and “Havana Affair,” as well as such classics as “Cretin Hop,” “Commando,” “Rockaway Beach,” “Sheena is a Punk Rocker,” “Do You Wanna Dance,” “I Wanna Be Sedated,” their Trashmen cover of “Surfin’ Bird,” and “Beat
